verdict.rationale: Mastra documents defining typed custom tools via `createTool()` with an `id`, `description`, zod `inputSchema`, `outputSchema`, and `execute` function, and its agents are built to reason over and call those tools in a TypeScript framework. Community users praise its ease of use and call it best in class for TypeScript. Missing for 10: a concrete agent-definition snippet showing tools attached to an agent in a few lines, and hands-on corroboration specific to tool typing and conciseness.
